description: RPLGD reading dose vs irradiated dose: two groups of black circles told apart only by fill - filled (6X_Accumulation, joined by a solid line) and open (6X_Normal, joined by a dashed line) - with small vertical SD error bars, a red reference line through the origin, and a legend with one sample of each inside the frame (top left). Journal figure (Kim et al. 2020, PLoS ONE 15:e0234829, Fig 2 panel (a); crop x 0-915, y 0-690 of the publisher's 1835x1388 PNG), 915x690 PNG. The source is a pixel-doubled low-resolution render (every pixel row and column repeats; markers ~8 px, lines 2-4 px). Axes have NO tick marks: positions are label centres (+/- 1 px). Marker centres from darkness-weighted centroids of the marker cores (+/- 1 px); the open markers at 1, 5 and 10 Gy coincide with the filled ones (same pixels, not resolvable) and at 50 Gy the two overlap (the open one's position is the visible blob, the filled one's is predicted from the data table through the label calibration). Positions are image pixels, origin top-left, integer = pixel centre. Provenance, licence and data truth: fixtures/real/PROVENANCE.md.

xAxis.notes: Dark-grey 4-px frame line (rows 582-585); no tick marks on any frame line. Labels 0-100 every 20 Gy (rows 590-624), positions are the label centres; the frame's right edge is x = 110, not a label.

yAxis.notes: Grey 4-px frame line (columns 214-217); no tick marks. Labels 0-120 every 20 (columns 150-188), positions are the label centres; y = 0 is 2.7 px above the bottom frame line and y = 120 is 22.6 px below the top one.

pitfalls: No tick marks on the frame; the x and y labels are centred on their values (the frame spans x 0-110 and y 0-125, so neither the right nor the top frame line is a labelled value).
The two series coincide at 1, 5 and 10 Gy (filled and open circle drawn on the same pixels) and overlap at 50 Gy; only at 100 Gy are the filled (118.7) and open (104.0) markers apart.
The marker at 1 Gy sits in the frame corner, merged with both axis lines; the solid, dashed and red lines all pass through every marker.
The markers are ~8 px across in a pixel-doubled render, barely thicker than the lines through them; the open marker's hole is 2 px.
The legend box holds a filled sample on a solid line and an open sample on a dashed line beside the series names: not data.
